errors.evidence: The x-axis tick marks range from 10 to 60. The data points exist in a range from approximately 8 to 64. The stated range of '10 to 65' is not accurate for either the axis ticks or the data's extent.
The starting data points for the 'Ours (Dynamic Seg)' and 'Ours (Static 4-Seg)' models are located before the 10-frame tick mark, at an x-coordinate of approximately 8.

This description is misleading because it fails to mention that the 'PLLaVA (DP 16)' model starts at a different x-coordinate (approximately 18 frames) than most of the other models (which start around 8 frames). This omission incorrectly implies all models are compared over the same starting range.

This phrase is incorrect. The 'PLLaVA (DP 16)' model does not cover the same range as the 'Ours' or 'PLLaVA (DP 8)' models, as it starts at approximately 18 frames, not near the beginning of the x-axis.
The final data point for the 'PLLaVA (DP 8)' model is at an x-coordinate closer to 64, not 65.
